scenes.name: CANCEL
lines: Can you cancel the squared term by choosing just one number?
只选一个数，就能消掉平方项吗？
When we cube this expression, the squared coefficient is three b plus three. So b must be minus one.
把这个式子立方，平方项系数是三倍的 b 加三，所以 b 必须等于负一。
At the next step use a fifth power. Each new coefficient leaves the earlier choices alone.
下一步用五次方。新的系数不会改变此前的选择。

scenes.name: DIFFERENTIATE
lines: Our series has integer coefficients and constant term one. In its prime power, the positive-degree coefficients below that prime are all multiples of it.
我们的级数系数为整数，常数项为一。取素数次幂后，次数大于零且小于该素数的系数都是这个素数的倍数。
Differentiate. The zero at degree n moves down to degree n minus one. The product rule puts the logarithmic derivative next to the power.
求导后，第 n 次的零降到第 n 减一次。乘积法则把对数导数和原来的幂连在一起。
Take remainders. In these degrees the power acts like one, so the selected coefficient of the logarithmic derivative must be a multiple of the prime.
取余后，在这些次数内，原来的幂相当于一，所以所选的对数导数系数一定是该素数的倍数。

scenes.name: CHECK THE DEGREE
lines: For Hanna's sequence the first examples are minus three and ten: multiples of three and five.
Hanna 数列中的前两个例子是负三和十，分别是三和五的倍数。
The rule starts at step two. And the coefficient to read is at degree n minus one, never degree n.
规律从第二步开始，并且要读取第 n 减一次的系数，而不是第 n 次。
